workload: Satisfy 8192 allocations of 16 bytes, filling the 16-byte pool and a second pool the way hook_malloc does for many short guest buffers.
notes: Median of 5 fresh processes is 159.233 ms; full spread (max-min)/median is 4.996%. alloc finds a free slot with list.index over up to 8192 flags, so filling a pool is quadratic. A first-fit cursor or free-list that still returns the lowest free index removes that scan; free must record holes so the addresses stay the same. The scan itself is inside alloc. tests/test_emulator.py::test_create_buffer and tests/test_libc.py::test_malloc (Android malloc hook) cover it. memory.py is not in #263 or #264. No open PRs.
